nodes.text: Does the longest arithmetic progression of primes in $\{1,\ldots,N\}$ have length $o(\log N)$?

#200 : [ErGr79] [ErGr80] primes | arithmetic progressions It follows from the prime number theorem that such a progression has length $\leq(1+o(1))\log N$.
